aiResearchSummary.text: Consure Medical is developing a Female fluid removal device and a Device for collecting material from a body cavity that use layered absorbent structures, self expanding collection components, and conduits for targeted urine and fecal capture. It is also creating Urine management systems and methods and Fecal management systems and methods using controlled suction, irrigation, and negative pressure canisters for active, closed loop excreta management. Together these efforts focus on urinary drainage, fecal collection, and integrated fluid control systems.
